summary: Today's cash register: opening, movements and closing of the physical cash register.
purpose: To take payments or record movements there must be an open cash session. It opens by counting the starting cash and closes by counting the ending cash: the system compares what was counted with what was recorded (cash count) and leaves the closing report.
tips: Each user can have only one open cash register at a time.
The cash icon on the floating bar is green when the cash register is open and orange when it's closed.
«Fill with last closing» copies the previous closing's count into the opening.
Cash count differences are explained in the closing notes.
